body_markdown:
KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, Fla.–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )–[Starfighters Space, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fstarfightersspace.com%2F&esheet=54642387&newsitemid=20261116249793&lan=en-US&anchor=Starfighters+Space%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=56d0a348969d764bfc89ded84395e9b8) (“Starfighters” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: FJET), the space company operating the world’s only commercial fleet of flight-ready Mach 2+ supersonic aircraft, announced today that it has filed its third-quarter 2026 Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”).


The Form 10-Q contains the Company’s financial statements and additional information regarding its results of operations, financial condition, liquidity, and business developments. The Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q is available on the SEC’s website at[www.sec.gov](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov&esheet=54642387&newsitemid=20261116249793&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov&index=2&md5=3a720a9b44117ebafcbd01d196bf82fa) and in the Investors section of the Company’s website at[www.starfightersspace.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.starfightersspace.com&esheet=54642387&newsitemid=20261116249793&lan=en-US&anchor=www.starfightersspace.com&index=3&md5=1abf9b6a037aa3b2606a834c3e215cc0) .


The Company also notes that its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, included an independent auditor’s report containing a going concern explanatory paragraph. This disclosure is being made pursuant to Section 610(b) of the NYSE American Company Guide and does not reflect any change or amendment to the Company’s previously reported financial statements or its 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K.


**About Starfighters Space, Inc.**


[Starfighters Space](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fstarfightersspace.com%2F&esheet=54642387&newsitemid=20261116249793&lan=en-US&anchor=Starfighters+Space&index=4&md5=971a253f5c04c9638e7ed56915c76714) operates its fleet of F-104 aircraft at Kennedy Space Center in Florida and the Midland International Air & Space Port in Texas, making it the only company in the world with the commercial capability to fly at sustained Mach 2+ speeds. The iconic F-104 jets are configurable as a platform for air-launched payloads, training for pilots, and to support RDT&E (Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation) for hypersonic technologies, missile defense systems, microgravity science, spaceflight hardware, advanced materials, and defense electronic systems.
